summary:
廢物管理本季 EPS 超預期4%，營收年增3.5%，防禦型現金流穩健。
• EPS 1.81 美元，較預估1.74超出3.98%。
• 營收6.23億美元（B級），年增3.47%穩定成長。
• 定價權與垃圾掩埋場護城河帶來穩定利潤率。
• 回收與再生能源（RNG）業務提供成長選擇權。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 超預期且營收穩定成長，反映 WM 透過定價權與營運效率穩定獲利的防禦特性。短期股價有業績與防禦屬性支撐，市場偏好其穩定現金流與股息成長。中期看回收升級與 RNG 投資的報酬兌現。追蹤指標：核心定價（core price）、收集量趨勢、RNG/回收資本支出報酬與自由現金流。31.4倍本益比對穩定成長股略高，估值已反映品質溢價。

需留意：經濟放緩降低工商業廢棄物量。；燃料與勞動成本上升壓抑利潤率。；本益比31.40對防禦型公用事業偏高。

summary_en:
Waste Management beat EPS by 4% with 3.5% revenue growth, on steady defensive cash flow.
• EPS of $1.81 beat the $1.74 estimate by 3.98%.
• Revenue of $6.23B grew a steady 3.47% year over year.
• Pricing power and landfill moat deliver stable margins.
• Recycling and renewable natural gas (RNG) offer growth optionality.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: an EPS beat with steady revenue growth reflects WM's defensive ability to deliver stable profit via pricing power and operating efficiency. Near-term the stock has earnings and defensive support, with the market favoring its stable cash flow and dividend growth. Mid-term watch returns from recycling upgrades and RNG investment. Track core price, volume trends, RNG/recycling capex returns, and free cash flow. A 31.4x P/E is a touch high for a steady grower, already pricing a quality premium.

Watch：An economic slowdown reduces commercial and industrial waste volumes.; Rising fuel and labor costs pressure margins.; A P/E of 31.40 is elevated for a defensive utility-like name.
